summary: Executed real Mongo integration tests for ingestion/cohort/views/ledger/jobs/cron plus live frontend navigation checks on preview URL. Backend suite produced meaningful adapter-to-adapter inconsistencies and one orders exactness bug; UI core flows passed with a minor mobile overflow offender.

critical.issue: Cohort IDs are inconsistent across adapters for the same seeded product and window (failing assertion at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration37_integration_real_mongo.py:244; observed two different cohort_id hashes). This breaks F06 shared-cohort consistency expectation.

Aggregation projection excludes currency/financials_complete, so aggregate_orders cannot filter invalid/wrong-currency orders. Repro fails at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration37_integration_real_mongo.py:413 (expected orders_count=1, actual=3). This can overstate exact own revenue/units (F07 risk).

ui_bugs.issue: Small residual horizontal overflow offender remains in header flex wrapper (page delta 0 but offender delta 13px detected by runtime sweep).

issues: Console warning: missing Description/aria-describedby on DialogContent (accessibility warning).

action_items: Fix cohort determinism/consistency so catalog_views, comparison_views, scanner/detail/intel_detail and market_share all resolve identical cohort_id for same evidence window.
Patch server._own_orders_aggregate projection to include currency + financials_complete (or avoid restrictive projection) before calling aggregate_orders.
Re-run iteration37 backend suite after fixes and verify failing lines 244 and 413 pass.
Tighten Market Share mobile header wrapping to eliminate 13px offender at 390px width.
critical_code_review_comments: server._own_orders_aggregate currently fetches only excluded/total/units/items, but aggregate_orders relies on financials_complete and currency for exactness filters.
Shared cohort contract still diverges between adapter paths; this directly undermines single source-of-truth pricing semantics.
Cron auth/envelope/duplicate behavior works under isolated route tests when queue execution is harmlessly monkeypatched.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned isolated disposable Mongo DB via MONGO_URL with random DB name; no application DB mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend integration suite now exists and uses real Mongo + integrity_indexes.ensure. Current status: 5/7 pass, 2 reproducible backend failures. Frontend live check confirms login, MyProducts (KPI shows 2303), detail panel, /insights, /price-intel, Market Share tabs, scanner, and mobile drawer behaviors; one minor mobile overflow offender remains.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 Cohort mismatch: Adapter paths do not produce one stable cohort identity for the same evidence window, indicating drift in cohort inputs/timing/filtering (likely now/cutoff path variance). RCA-2 Own orders exactness: _own_orders_aggregate projection strips fields needed by aggregate_orders filters, causing invalid orders to be counted as exact. Repro in test file lines 413/244 with real Mongo writes.
